# Plugins

33 of 41 supported, called with `evaluate`. Plugins that reach outside the process go through the [callout policy](../guide/security.md).
Descriptions are the first sentence of each entry's page in Microsoft's [KQL documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/) (CC BY 4.0); the names link there. "gokql" says whether this engine accepts the entry, probed from the code; Notes are gokql's own.

### Data reshaping plugins

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [bag_unpack](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/bag-unpack-plugin) | yes | The `bag_unpack` plugin unpacks a single column of type `dynamic`, by treating each property bag top-level slot as a column. |  |
| [narrow](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/narrow-plugin) | yes | The `narrow` plugin "unpivots" a wide table into a table with three columns: |  |
| [pivot](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/pivot-plugin) | yes | Rotates a table by turning the unique values from one column in the input table into multiple columns in the output table and performs aggregations as required on any remaining column values that will appear in the final output. |  |

### General plugins

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [dcount_intersect](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/dcount-intersect-plugin) | yes | Calculates intersection between N sets based on `hll` values (N in range of [2..16]), and returns N `dcount` values. |  |
| [infer_storage_schema](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/infer-storage-schema-plugin) | yes | This plugin infers the schema of external data, and returns it as CSL schema string. | Local files and folders, http files; csv, tsv, psv, scsv, txt, json, multijson. |
| [infer_storage_schema_with_suggestions](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/infer-storage-schema-with-suggestions-plugin) | yes | This `infer_storage_schema_with_suggestions` plugin infers the schema of external data and returns a JSON object. | As infer_storage_schema. |
| [ipv4_lookup](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/ipv4-lookup-plugin) | yes | The `ipv4_lookup` plugin looks up an IPv4 value in a lookup table and returns rows with matched values. |  |
| [ipv6_lookup](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/ipv6-lookup-plugin) | yes | The `ipv6_lookup` plugin looks up an IPv6 value in a lookup table and returns rows with matched values. |  |
| [preview](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/preview-plugin) | yes | Returns a table with up to the specified number of rows from the input record set, and the total number of records in the input record set. |  |
| [schema_merge](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/schema-merge-plugin) | yes | Merges tabular schema definitions into a unified schema. |  |

### Machine learning plugins

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [autocluster](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/autocluster-plugin) | yes | `autocluster` finds common patterns of discrete attributes (dimensions) in the data. | Same output shape; ADX's selection is unspecified, so the segments found can differ on large inputs. |
| [basket](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/basket-plugin) | yes | The `basket` plugin finds frequent patterns of attributes in the data and returns the patterns that pass a frequency threshold in that data. | Same output shape; ADX's selection is unspecified. |
| [diffpatterns](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/diffpatterns-plugin) | yes | Compares two datasets of the same structure and finds patterns of discrete attributes (dimensions) that characterize differences between the two datasets. | Closed-itemset contrast: ADX's segments appear with the same counts, possibly with a few more. |
| [diffpatterns_text](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/diffpatterns-text-plugin) | yes | Compares two datasets of string values and finds text patterns that characterize differences between the two datasets. | Closed positional token patterns; ADX's patterns appear, possibly with more. |

### Query connectivity plugins

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [ai_chat_completion](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/ai-chat-completion-plugin) | yes | The `ai_chat_completion` plugin enables generating chat completions using language models, supporting AI-related scenarios such as conversational AI and interactive systems. | Any OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint (azure_openai callout rule). Key from GOKQL_AI_API_KEY. |
| [ai_chat_completion_prompt](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/ai-chat-completion-prompt-plugin) | yes | The `ai_chat_completion_prompt` plugin enables generating chat completions using language models, supporting AI-related scenarios such as conversational AI and interactive systems. | As ai_chat_completion. |
| [ai_embeddings](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/ai-embeddings-plugin) | yes | The `ai_embeddings` plugin allows embedding of text using language models, enabling various AI-related scenarios such as Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) applications and semantic search. | Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (azure_openai callout rule); an empty connection string uses gokql's embedder. Key from GOKQL_AI_API_KEY. |
| [azure_digital_twins_query_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/azure-digital-twins-query-request-plugin) | **no** | The `azure_digital_twins_query_request` plugin runs an Azure Digital Twins query as part of a Kusto Query Language (KQL) query. | Not implemented. |
| [cosmosdb_sql_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/cosmosdb-plugin) | **no** | The `cosmosdb_sql_request` plugin sends a SQL query to an Azure Cosmos DB SQL network endpoint and returns the results of the query. | Not implemented. |
| [dax_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/dax-request-plugin) | **no** | The `dax_request` plugin runs a Data Analysis Expressions (DAX) query against a Power BI semantic model and returns the results as a table. | Not implemented. |
| [http_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/http-request-plugin) | yes | The `http_request` plugin sends an HTTP GET request and converts the response into a table. | Needs a webapi rule in the callout policy (guide/security.md). Can start a query. |
| [http_request_post](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/http-request-post-plugin) | yes | The `http_request_post` plugin sends an HTTP POST request and converts the response into a table. | Needs a webapi rule in the callout policy. |
| [mysql_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/mysql-request-plugin) | **no** | The `mysql_request` plugin sends a SQL query to an Azure MySQL Server network endpoint and returns the first rowset in the results. | Not implemented: needs a database driver. |
| [postgresql_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/postgresql-request-plugin) | **no** | The `postgresql_request` plugin sends a SQL query to an Azure PostgreSQL Server network endpoint and returns the first rowset in the results. | Not implemented: needs a database driver. |
| [sql_request](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/sql-request-plugin) | **no** | The `sql_request` plugin sends a SQL query to an Azure SQL Server network endpoint and returns the results. | Not implemented: needs a database driver. |

### User and sequence analytics plugins

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [active_users_count](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/active-users-count-plugin) | yes | Calculates distinct count of values, where each value has appeared in at least a minimum number of periods in a lookback period. |  |
| [activity_counts_metrics](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/activity-counts-metrics-plugin) | yes | Calculates useful activity metrics for each time window compared/aggregated to all previous time windows. |  |
| [activity_engagement](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/activity-engagement-plugin) | yes | Calculates activity engagement ratio based on ID column over a sliding timeline window. |  |
| [activity_metrics](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/activity-metrics-plugin) | yes | Calculates useful metrics that include distinct count values, distinct count of new values, retention rate, and churn rate. |  |
| [funnel_sequence](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/funnel-sequence-plugin) | yes | Calculates distinct count of users who have taken a sequence of states, and the distribution of previous/next states that have led to/were followed by the sequence. |  |
| [funnel_sequence_completion](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/funnel-sequence-completion-plugin) | yes | Calculates a funnel of completed sequence steps while comparing different time periods. |  |
| [new_activity_metrics](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/new-activity-metrics-plugin) | yes | Calculates useful activity metrics (distinct count values, distinct count of new values, retention rate, and churn rate) for the cohort of `New Users`. |  |
| [rolling_percentile](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/rolling-percentile-plugin) | yes | Returns an estimate for the specified percentile of the ValueColumn population in a rolling (sliding) BinsPerWindow size window per BinSize. |  |
| [rows_near](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/rows-near-plugin) | yes | Finds rows near a specified condition. |  |
| [sequence_detect](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/sequence-detect-plugin) | yes | Detects sequence occurrences based on provided predicates. |  |
| [session_count](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/session-count-plugin) | yes | Calculates the session count based on the ID column over a timeline. |  |
| [sliding_window_counts](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/sliding-window-counts-plugin) | yes | Calculates counts and distinct count of values in a sliding window over a lookback period, using the technique described in the Perform aggregations over a sliding window example. |  |
